Independently rebuilt the exact 36-vertex restricted matching complex: f=(36,375,1050), 1,461 nonempty simplices and no dimension above two. Reimplemented staged lexicographic toggle pairing and directed Hasse incidence graph without trusting stored results: 375 codimension-one pairs, critical counts (1,0,710), 3,900 oriented incidences and a full 1,461-vertex acyclic topological sort. Discrete Morse then gives the integral wedge of 710 two-spheres, rather than inferring it from mod-two Betti ranks. Independently recomputed signed fixed-face Hopf traces for every one of 4!5!=2,880 block permutations; all 35 class characters match actual character_table.csv, the class-weighted average is zero, and the multiplicities file contains 22 nonzero constituents summing to dimension 710. Normalization, empty-face exclusion, symmetry action and block saturation were explicitly handled.
